name: When should I install an access panel instead of patching the drywall permanently?
description: Install an access panel over shutoff valves or cleanouts that require future maintenance; permanently patch closed, continuous pipe runs.

mainEntity.name: When should I install an access panel instead of patching the drywall permanently?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need an access panel or a permanent drywall patch depends on whether you will need ongoing access to that plumbing component. Shutoff valves, cleanouts, shower mixing valves, and whole-house filtration connections should typically be covered with a removable access panel for future maintenance. Standard supply lines, copper re-pipes, or drain lines with no mechanical joints should be permanently patched, textured, and painted to restore the wall to its original appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install an access panel over shutoff valves or cleanouts that require future maintenance; permanently patch closed, continuous pipe runs.
